_what: Content metadata for one edit. Copy to <workdir>/brief.json and fill in.

_notes.product_name: Shown on the opening card. Keep it short — it is read in under a second.
_notes.product_model: Optional second line. Omit if it adds nothing.
_notes.content_family: Small label, e.g. ASMR UNBOXING. Omit to hide the label.
_notes.optional_hook: At most a few words. Left empty by default — this format is not title-heavy.
